prompt_meta.title: Trust Layer (GA): Ratings & Reviews for Players/Venues/Clubs + Reputation Badges + Profile Social Proof (API + Web + Mobile)

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0011 report is shared with ChatGPT
owner_actions.instruction: Approve Rating/Review rules and badge names/thresholds documented in ops/RATINGS_RULES.md and ops/REPUTATION_MODEL.md. Approval only; no execution.

step_objectives.goal: Add a GA-grade Trust Layer: structured ratings/reviews for players, venues, and clubs; aggregate reputation; and show social proof in profiles to drive safer matches and retention.
outcomes: Players can rate other players after a completed game (one rating per rater->ratee per game)
Venues can be rated when a game had a venue attached (after completion)
Clubs can be rated under a clear eligibility policy (IDE chooses policy; must document and enforce)
Aggregated reputation is computed and displayed: averages, counts, and badges
Abuse-resistant controls exist: eligibility checks, edit windows, report review, and anti-spam constraints
Web + Mobile UX exists for: leaving ratings, viewing reputation summaries, and seeing badges
All visible text localized KO/EN via shared dictionary
Docs updated to support future: moderation UI, verified profiles, ranking feeds
constraints: No external review providers or moderation SaaS.
No public “wall of shame”: avoid exposing personal data beyond reputation summary; IDE must document safe display choices.
No complex ML scoring: simple deterministic aggregation is fine, but must be documented and testable.
definition_of_done: IDE ensures Docker/infra is running (auto-start if needed) and migrations applied
API endpoints exist for creating/updating ratings, listing ratings summary, and viewing user/venue/club reputation summaries
Eligibility enforced server-side (only valid raters can rate; only after game completion)
Review reporting endpoint exists (reuse safety/report concepts or implement a new review-report model; document)
Web: rating flows available from game detail/completed state and profile/venue/club pages show summaries
Mobile: same core rating flow and reputation viewing
Docs created/updated: ops/RATINGS_RULES.md, ops/REPUTATION_MODEL.md, ops/REVIEW_MODERATION_PLACEHOLDERS.md, ops/API_CONTRACTS.md updated

deliverables_outcomes.goal: No owner execution; infra must be up for DB-backed reputation.
requirements: Ensure Docker daemon is running (auto-start/install attempt as needed).
Ensure infra containers are up (compose up if needed).
Apply DB migrations required for ratings/reputation.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes docker info + compose ps evidence (if used)

requirements: Rating scale must be defined (e.g., 1-5).
Player rating must be linked to gameId, raterId, rateeUserId.
Venue rating must be linked to gameId, raterId, venueId (only if venueId exists on game).
Club rating must be linked to raterId and clubId under an eligibility rule (IDE chooses; must document and enforce).
Support optional short structured feedback (categories) and optional comment, with strict length limits (abuse resistance).
Support updating a rating within a bounded window (IDE chooses) or not; must document tradeoff.
acceptance_criteria: Docs define schemas and uniqueness constraints (one rating per entity per game where applicable)
API tests validate uniqueness and eligibility checks

requirements: Player ratings: only host/approved participants can rate other approved participants of the same completed game.
Venue ratings: only approved participants of a completed game with that venue can rate it.
Club ratings: clear rule chosen and enforced (e.g., only participants of a completed club-hosted game, or only approved club members with minimum tenure).
Prevent self-rating and duplicate rating attempts.
Define cancellation behavior (CANCELLED games cannot be rated) and enforce.
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover allowed/denied cases (unauth, requested/waitlist, cancelled, not in game, self-rate, duplicate)

requirements: Compute summary fields for each target type: average rating, rating count, and optionally category averages (if categories exist).
Badge system: deterministic badges derived from thresholds (count + average + safety signals). IDE chooses badge set; must document.
Aggregation strategy documented (simple average vs bayesian smoothing etc.).
Ensure performance: avoid N+1 queries; document approach.
acceptance_criteria: API tests validate aggregation correctness on sample data
Docs list badges and exact thresholds/logic

requirements: Users can report a rating/review (reason codes + optional note).
Persist report with metadata: reporterId, targetType, targetId, ratingId, createdAt.
Moderation placeholders doc: define future admin review actions (hide review, remove badge, suspend user) but do not build admin UI now.
acceptance_criteria: API tests verify report creation and validation
Docs define reason codes and moderation plan

deliverables_outcomes.goal: End-to-end rating flows and social proof.
requirements: From a completed game detail: users can rate players (and venue/club if applicable).
Profile page shows reputation summary and badges.
Venue and club pages show rating summaries and counts.
Localization KO/EN for all visible strings.
acceptance_criteria: Web tests cover: completed game rating CTA appears, submit rating flow mocked, profile shows badges

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Same core trust loop on mobile.
requirements: From a completed game detail: rating entry UI exists (simple form).
Profile shows reputation summary and badges.
Venue and club screens show rating summaries.
Localization KO/EN.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile tests cover: rating screen renders, submission state handling mocked, badges render

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Make reputation a stable platform feature.
requirements: Create ops/RATINGS_RULES.md (eligibility, timing, duplicates, cancellation handling, comment limits).
Create ops/REPUTATION_MODEL.md (aggregation, badge logic, display rules).
Create ops/REVIEW_MODERATION_PLACEHOLDERS.md (future admin actions, audit trail needs).
Update ops/API_CONTRACTS.md with endpoints, payloads, and errors.
acceptance_criteria: Tradeoffs recorded clearly (edit window, comment policy, aggregation method)

tasks.name: Ensure infra running (executor-owned)
tasks.objective: Auto-start Docker/infra and confirm DB connectivity.
acceptance: docker + infra running OR BLOCKED with exact OS/permission limitation

tasks.name: Rating models + migrations
tasks.objective: Add rating/review models for players/venues/clubs with uniqueness constraints.
constraints: Auditable and abuse-resistant; document edit/comment policy
acceptance: migrations applied; constraints validated in tests

tasks.name: API endpoints + tests
tasks.objective: Implement create/update/list/summary endpoints with eligibility enforcement and aggregation tests.
acceptance: API tests cover core flows and edge cases

tasks.name: Review reporting + tests
tasks.objective: Enable reporting of reviews and persist audit records.
constraints: Reason codes required; moderation placeholders doc
acceptance: API tests cover report creation and validation

tasks.name: Web + Mobile UX
tasks.objective: Add rating UI from completed game and show reputation summaries/badges on profile/venue/club.

tasks.name: Docs + manifest + report
tasks.objective: Write docs, update manifest, produce complete report.
acceptance: Docs complete; manifest updated; report complete

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any execution to the owner. Choose implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0011.report.json with no placeholders.
